metadata.question: Did the Sonoran Desert experience land surface temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius in 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) products: MOD11A2 (Terra) or MYD11A2 (Aqua) for 2019 - Location: Sonoran Desert (approximate bounds: ~27-34°N, ~108-116°W) - Date: Full year 2019 to maximize chances of finding extreme temperatures 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed - we want to find if ANY pixels exceeded 75°C - LST products have QA bands, but for detecting extreme temperatures, we should check raw values first - 75°C is extremely high (typical desert summer max is ~60-70°C), so this is looking for exceptional events 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid Zero vs Null: LST should never be 0K or null in desert - check for valid temperature range - If we find temperatures > 75°C anywhere in the collection, answer A (Yes) - If no temperatures exceed 75°C but valid data exists, answer B (No) - Check collection size and pixel counts to detect C1/C2 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Sonoran Desert region (approximate bounds) const sonoran = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-116, 27], [-116, 34], [-108, 34], [-108, 27], [-116, 27]] ]); // 2. Load MODIS LST data for 2019 const lstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A2') .filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31') .filterBounds(sonoran) .select('LST_Day_1km'); const collectionSize = lstCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log('Collection size:', collectionSize); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No MODIS LST data found for Sonoran Desert in 2019.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Convert from Kelvin (scaled by 0.02) to Celsius and find maximum const lstCelsius = lstCollection.map(function(img) { return img.multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']); }); // 4. Get maximum temperature across all images const maxLST = lstCelsius.max(); // 5. Check if any pixels exceed 75°C const stats = maxLST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: sonoran, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxTemp = stats['LST_Day_1km_max']; const pixelCount = stats['LST_Day_1km_count']; console.log('Images in collection:', collectionSize); console.log('Valid pixels analyzed:', pixelCount); console.log('Maximum temperature found (°C):', maxTemp ? maxTemp.toFixed(2) : 'null'); // 6. Validation and answer if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (maxTemp === null || maxTemp === undefined || isNaN(maxTemp)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (maxTemp < -100 || maxTemp > 100) { console.log('Temperature out of realistic range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (maxTemp > 75) { console.log('Temperature exceeded 75°C threshold.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Temperature did not exceed 75°C threshold.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
